rcb-death-seasons-worse.label: Seasons RCB's death economy was worse than the league's
rcb-death-seasons-worse.dataset: CricField warehouse: deliveries ⨝ innings ⨝ matches (Cricsheet ball-by-ball, IPL 2008–2026)
rcb-death-seasons-worse.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) THEN (d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END), 2) rcb, ROUND(SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END), 2) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) rcbBalls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

len-coverage.label: Share of RCB death balls (2022–2026) with a length label
len-coverage.dataset: CricField warehouse: delivery_commentary length labels (parsed from ball-by-ball commentary) ⨝ deliveries
len-coverage.query: SELECT COALESCE(c.length, 'Unlabelled') len, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_boundary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) boundaries, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dots, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wkts FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id LEFT JOIN delivery_commentary c ON c.delivery_id = d.delivery_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2026 GROUP BY len

league-miss-cost.query: SELECT COALESCE(c.length, 'Unlabelled') len, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_boundary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) boundaries, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dots, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wkts FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id LEFT JOIN delivery_commentary c ON c.delivery_id = d.delivery_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2026 GROUP BY len

death-econ-by-season.label: Death-overs economy by season: RCB bowling vs IPL
death-econ-by-season.dataset: CricField warehouse: deliveries ⨝ innings ⨝ matches (Cricsheet ball-by-ball, IPL 2008–2026)
death-econ-by-season.filters: Overs 16–20, regulation innings; runs charged to bowler (byes/leg-byes excluded) ÷ legal balls × 6
death-econ-by-season.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) THEN (d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END), 2) rcb, ROUND(SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END), 2) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) rcbBalls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
